description_en: Queries the status of a trail
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail get-trail-status --name trail-test --is-organization-trail false --api-version 2017-12-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrailStatus

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail.  
The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length, must start with a lowercase letter, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The trail name must be unique within an account
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪名称。  
长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
同一账号内跟踪名称不可重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the status of a multi-account trail. Valid values:  

true: queries the status of a multi-account trail.  

false (default): does not query the status of a multi-account trail. Instead, the status of a single-account trail is queried
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪的状态。取值：  

true：查询多账号跟踪的状态。  

false（默认值）：不查询多账号跟踪的状态，即查询单账号跟踪的状态
parameters.name: is_organization_trail

IsLogging.description_en: Indicates whether log record is enabled

LatestDeliveryError.description_en: The log information of the most recent event delivery error
LatestDeliveryError.description_zh: 最后一次行为追踪异常的日志信息
LatestDeliveryError.example: write sls failed, exception: the parent of sub user must be project owner, itemscount: 1

LatestDeliveryTime.description_en: The most recent time when an event was successfully delivered
LatestDeliveryTime.description_zh: 最后一次成功记录行为的时间

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the user started the trail
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 用户上一次开启该跟踪的时间

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the user stopped the trail
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 用户上一次停止该跟踪的时间
